CREATE TABLE agent_consents (

    allowed_scopes_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',

    selector_schema_version TEXT NOT NULL,
    selector_resolution_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',

    command_categories_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    maximum_risk TEXT NOT NULL
      CHECK(maximum_risk IN ('read_only','low','elevated','high')),
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'
      CHECK(status IN ('active','superseded','revoked')),
    exception_scope TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'installation'
      CHECK(exception_scope IN ('global','installation')),
    exceptions_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    confirmed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    revoked_at TEXT,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

objects.name: agent_host_activity_evidence
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE agent_host_activity_evidence (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    installation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES agent_installations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    activation_run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES reconcile_runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    agent_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    host_variant TEXT NOT NULL,
    component_key TEXT NOT NULL
      CHECK(component_key IN ('memory_tools','lifecycle')),
    signal_name TEXT NOT NULL
      CHECK(signal_name IN (
        'brain_prepare','brain_recall','brain_digest',
        'session_start','pre_compact','session_end','post_compact'
      )),
    tide_mind_version TEXT NOT NULL,
    adapter_version TEXT NOT NULL,
    projection_version TEXT NOT NULL,
    host_version TEXT NOT NULL,
    evidence_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    observed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    CHECK(
      (component_key = 'memory_tools' AND signal_name IN (
        'brain_prepare','brain_recall','brain_digest'
      )) OR
      (component_key = 'lifecycle' AND signal_name IN (
        'session_start','pre_compact','session_end','post_compact'
      ))
    ),
    UNIQUE(
      activation_run_id, installation_id, component_key, signal_name, tide_mind_version,
      adapter_version, projection_version, host_version
    )
)

objects.name: agent_installations
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE agent_installations (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    family TEXT NOT NULL,
    host_variant TEXT NOT NULL,
    runtime_realm TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local_macos',
    profile_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    install_key TEXT NOT NULL,
    distribution_id TEXT,
    provenance TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown',
    os_user_identity TEXT,
    display_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    display_alias TEXT,
    config_root TEXT,
    executable_path TEXT,
    app_path TEXT,
    detected_version TEXT,
    version_detection_method TEXT,
    agent_id TEXT UNIQUE,
    desired_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unmanaged'
      CHECK(desired_state IN ('unmanaged','managed','disabled','removed')),
    tombstoned_at TEXT,
    tombstone_reason TEXT,
    consent_envelope_id TEXT REFERENCES agent_consents(id),
    consented_at TEXT,
    supported_capability INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
      CHECK(supported_capability BETWEEN 0 AND 4),
    desired_capability INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
      CHECK(desired_capability BETWEEN 0 AND 4),
    verified_capability INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
      CHECK(verified_capability BETWEEN 0 AND 4),
    delivery_summary TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cataloged'
      CHECK(delivery_summary IN ('cataloged','detectable','guided','hybrid','fully_managed')),
    verification_summary TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unverified'
      CHECK(verification_summary IN ('unverified','verifying','verified','stale','failed','mixed')),
    health_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'discovered',
    status_reason TEXT,
    reconcile_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'idle'
      CHECK(reconcile_state IN (
        'idle','planning','awaiting_consent','applying','verifying','compensating',
        'needs_recovery','backoff','paused'
      )),
    last_detected_at TEXT,
    last_verified_at TEXT,
    verification_result_id TEXT REFERENCES verification_results(id),
    last_repaired_at TEXT,
    metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, bridge_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'serving' CHECK(bridge_state IN ('serving','stopped')), bridge_state_reason TEXT, host_components_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'loaded_unknown' CHECK(host_components_state IN ('loaded_unknown','awaiting_reload','deactivated_verified')),
    UNIQUE(runtime_realm, install_key)
)

CREATE TRIGGER tm_recovery_barrier_protect_active_update
BEFORE UPDATE ON recovery_barriers
WHEN OLD.status = 'active' AND NOT (
  (
    tm_recovery_barrier_mode() = 'clear'
    AND tm_recovery_barrier_id() = OLD.barrier_id
    AND tm_recovery_barrier_expected_evidence() = OLD.evidence
    AND OLD.owner_leader_instance_id = tm_recovery_barrier_leader_instance()
    AND OLD.owner_leader_epoch = tm_recovery_barrier_leader_epoch()
    AND OLD.owner_instance_id = tm_recovery_barrier_owner_instance()
    AND OLD.owner_attempt_id = tm_recovery_barrier_attempt()
    AND OLD.owner_fencing_token = tm_recovery_barrier_fence()
    AND NEW.status = 'cleared'
    AND NEW.clear_evidence = tm_recovery_barrier_clear_evidence()
    AND NEW.barrier_id = OLD.barrier_id
    AND NEW.owner_run_id = OLD.owner_run_id
    AND NEW.reason_code = OLD.reason_code
    AND NEW.recovery_episode_id = OLD.recovery_episode_id
    AND NEW.evidence = OLD.evidence
    AND NEW.owner_leader_instance_id = OLD.owner_leader_instance_id
    AND NEW.owner_leader_epoch = OLD.owner_leader_epoch
    AND NEW.owner_instance_id = OLD.owner_instance_id
    AND NEW.owner_attempt_id = OLD.owner_attempt_id
    AND NEW.owner_fencing_token = OLD.owner_fencing_token
  )
  OR
  (
    tm_recovery_barrier_mode() = 'rebind'
    AND tm_recovery_barrier_id() = OLD.barrier_id
    AND tm_recovery_barrier_expected_evidence() = OLD.evidence
    AND tm_recovery_barrier_expected_leader_instance() = OLD.owner_leader_instance_id
    AND tm_recovery_barrier_expected_leader_epoch() = OLD.owner_leader_epoch
    AND tm_recovery_barrier_expected_owner_instance() = OLD.owner_instance_id
    AND tm_recovery_barrier_expected_attempt() = OLD.owner_attempt_id
    AND tm_recovery_barrier_expected_fence() = OLD.owner_fencing_token
    AND NEW.status = 'active'
    AND NEW.barrier_id = OLD.barrier_id
    AND NEW.owner_run_id = OLD.owner_run_id
    AND NEW.reason_code = OLD.reason_code
    AND NEW.recovery_episode_id = OLD.recovery_episode_id
    AND NEW.evidence = OLD.evidence
    AND NEW.owner_leader_instance_id = tm_recovery_barrier_leader_instance()
    AND NEW.owner_leader_epoch = tm_recovery_barrier_leader_epoch()
    AND NEW.owner_instance_id = tm_recovery_barrier_owner_instance()
    AND NEW.owner_attempt_id = tm_recovery_barrier_attempt()
    AND NEW.owner_fencing_token = tm_recovery_barrier_fence()
    AND NEW.clear_evidence IS NULL
    AND NEW.cleared_at IS NULL
  )
)
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'active recovery barrier requires fenced Store mutation context');
END

WHEN (

  OR NEW.recovery_reason IS NOT OLD.recovery_reason
) AND (
  tm_recovery_barrier_mode() IS NULL
  OR NEW.recovery_barrier IS NOT (
    SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM recovery_barriers WHERE status = 'active'
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
  )
  OR NEW.recovery_reason IS NOT (
    SELECT reason_code
    FROM recovery_barriers
    WHERE status = 'active'
    ORDER BY created_at, barrier_id
    LIMIT 1

)
BEGIN

END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_tag_usage_after_delete
        AFTER DELETE ON nodes
        WHEN OLD.tags IS NOT NULL
          AND COALESCE(OLD.archived, 0) = 0
          AND COALESCE(OLD.is_superseded, 0) = 0
        BEGIN
            UPDATE tag_usage SET
                node_count = node_count - 1,
                last_updated = datetime('now')
            WHERE tag IN (
                SELECT value FROM json_each(CASE WHEN json_valid(OLD.tags) = 1 THEN OLD.tags ELSE '[]' END) WHERE typeof(value) = 'text'
            );
            DELETE FROM tag_usage WHERE node_count <= 0;
        END

objects.name: trg_tag_usage_after_insert

CREATE TRIGGER trg_tag_usage_after_insert
        AFTER INSERT ON nodes
        WHEN NEW.tags IS NOT NULL
          AND COALESCE(NEW.archived, 0) = 0
          AND COALESCE(NEW.is_superseded, 0) = 0
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO tag_usage(tag, node_count, last_updated)
            SELECT DISTINCT value, 1, datetime('now')
            FROM json_each(CASE WHEN json_valid(NEW.tags) = 1 THEN NEW.tags ELSE '[]' END)
            WHERE typeof(value) = 'text' AND length(value) > 0
            ON CONFLICT(tag) DO UPDATE SET
                node_count = node_count + 1,
                last_updated = datetime('now');
        END

        AFTER UPDATE OF tags, archived, is_superseded ON nodes
        BEGIN
            UPDATE tag_usage SET
                node_count = node_count - 1,
                last_updated = datetime('now')
            WHERE COALESCE(OLD.archived, 0) = 0
              AND COALESCE(OLD.is_superseded, 0) = 0
              AND tag IN (
                  SELECT value FROM json_each(CASE WHEN json_valid(COALESCE(OLD.tags, '[]')) = 1 THEN COALESCE(OLD.tags, '[]') ELSE '[]' END)
                  WHERE typeof(value) = 'text'
              );
            INSERT INTO tag_usage(tag, node_count, last_updated)
            SELECT DISTINCT value, 1, datetime('now')
            FROM json_each(CASE WHEN json_valid(COALESCE(NEW.tags, '[]')) = 1 THEN COALESCE(NEW.tags, '[]') ELSE '[]' END)
            WHERE typeof(value) = 'text'
              AND length(value) > 0
              AND COALESCE(NEW.archived, 0) = 0
              AND COALESCE(NEW.is_superseded, 0) = 0
            ON CONFLICT(tag) DO UPDATE SET
                node_count = node_count + 1,
                last_updated = datetime('now');
            DELETE FROM tag_usage WHERE node_count <= 0;
        END
